attributes.name: Flayed Man
attributes.powers:
The Flayed Man is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits.

Before you act, the Flayed Man deals 1d6 Combat damage to any character that has the Dwarf trait, then deals an amount of Combat damage to each character at this location equal to that character's number of mythic charges.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
